name: B10-0486/2026 (PfE) – Escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of Houthi attacks and implications for regional security
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns attacks by the Houthis, an Iran-backed armed group in Yemen, on Saudi airports and oil sites in October 2026, and on ships in the Red Sea. It asks for these attacks to stop, for shipping to be protected under international law, and for Iran to stop arming the Houthis. It also calls for sanctions, safer energy supplies, and better checks so EU aid to Yemen is not diverted. The text is a statement of position; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet; it is a formal request for action, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Iran, shipping firms, seafarers and EU aid partners.
- **What happens next:** The text goes to EU governments, the Commission and the countries named; they decide whether to act.
